digest.component_or_area: LLM completion verification and workflow recovery orchestration
propositions: completion.py and completion_recovery.py each exceed or sit at the 800 LOC module-size CI cap, blocking any edit without prior extraction

four distinct concerns in completion.py (operation orchestration, child-closure gate, epic-bug screen, verdict reconciliation) and three in completion_recovery.py (criteria surface/bounds, failure taxonomy, recovery orchestration) must be separated into modules with clear contractual boundaries along existing call-graph seams

all moved symbols must remain patchable at their re-export facades (completion.py.__all__, completion_recovery.py.__all__) and at their new module homes to keep test monkeypatch targets and imports valid

decomposition preserves all public signatures and re-exports; internal consumers repoint to new homes; behavioral equivalence is verified by running all existing test suites with only import-path and monkeypatch-target updates
the resulting eight modules (four edited/created, four moved-into) must each fall within 200-500 LOC range with hard bounds of 100-700 LOC and zero lines > 800
